internal.title: High Latency Incident in Ad Service Due to Resource Exhaustion
internal.body:
On 2026-11-08 at 12:09 UTC, the Ad service experienced a high latency alert (ServiceLatencyHigh). Diagnosis confirmed resource exhaustion as the root cause, indicated by very high CPU utilization and elevated p95 latency with low error rates. The flag 'adHighCpu' was disabled at 12:29 UTC, which led to recovery and normalization of latency metrics. The incident was resolved promptly with no lasting impact on service availability.

Timeline:
- 12:09:31: Alert received
- 12:29:11: Diagnosis confirmed resource exhaustion
- 12:29:18: Flag 'adHighCpu' disabled
- 12:29:18: Recovery verified

Actions taken: Disabled the CPU-related flag to alleviate resource exhaustion.

Please monitor CPU utilization closely to prevent recurrence.
